limp: The final whistle blows. {name} takes one limping step, then drops to the turf. Players from both teams race in.

triggers.title: It already happened.
triggers.copy: There, a tiny caterpillar glowing against {name}'s skin. It has already bitten. Something impossible is leaking out.

triggers.title: One drop goes the wrong way.
triggers.copy: A teammate pours water over {name}'s face. One shining droplet stops in midair, turns, and sinks into their forehead.

triggers.title: The chant finds a heartbeat.
triggers.copy: The physio's compressions fall into time with the crowd. On the final beat, a pulse of light rolls out from {name}.

triggers.title: That is not standard equipment.
triggers.copy: The groundskeeper dabs {name} with a battered old sponge. It wrings itself out, releasing a shower of impossible sparks.

triggers.title: Everyone should stand back.
triggers.copy: The smelling salts reach {name}. The resulting sneeze ripples every nearby shirt and makes the scoreboard blink.

triggers.title: The ice refuses to stay put.
triggers.copy: An ice pack touches {name}'s head. The cubes escape and begin circling like tiny frozen moons.

triggers.title: STRONG MAN STRONG DRINK.
triggers.copy: Someone gives {name} a bottle of STRONG MAN STRONG DRINK. The liquid changes color, bubbles upward, and glows through their cheeks.

triggers.title: Its aim is suspiciously good.
triggers.copy: A sprinkler swivels toward the huddle and fires one precise stream at {name}. Then it politely shuts itself off.

triggers.title: The shin guard has a message.
triggers.copy: The physio removes {name}'s buzzing shin guard. Glowing symbols race across its inner surface.

triggers.title: That was not here at kickoff.
triggers.copy: A teammate empties {name}'s boot. A warm, sparkling pebble drops onto the grass and hums.

triggers.title: It is rolling uphill.
triggers.detail: No slope · no touch · one eye
triggers.copy: The match ball rolls uphill, nudges {name}'s head, and opens one glowing eye before becoming perfectly ordinary again.

triggers.title: Someone celebrated too early.
triggers.copy: A confetti cannon fires into the huddle. One golden strip lands on {name} and settles like a tiny cape.

triggers.title: A selection has been made.
triggers.copy: An iridescent feather drifts onto {name}'s chest. Somewhere above the stand, a pigeon gives one solemn salute.

triggers.title: The numbers have disappeared.
triggers.copy: The physio checks {name}'s temperature. The display abandons numbers and reads only: HERO.

triggers.title: The paddles fire themselves.
triggers.copy: The defibrillator activates before touching {name}. Energy crosses the gap in the shape of a brilliant star.

powers.omen: The grass around {name}'s boots bends backward. The stadium lights seem a fraction too slow.
powers.reveal: FWOOSH! {name} floats upright, and the world blurs around a brand-new hero.

powers.omen: For one impossible frame, {name} is standing in two places at once.
powers.reveal: ZIP! The first {name} vanishes. The second waves from ten yards away.

powers.omen: Static crawls over {name}'s boots and the nearby match ball starts to hum.
powers.reveal: KRA-KOOM! {name} rises behind a crackling ball of bottled thunder.

powers.omen: A red glow pulses beneath {name}'s kit. Heat ripples through the huddle.
powers.reveal: WHUMPF! {name} floats upright in a crown of flame. The referee reaches for the extinguisher.

powers.omen: The physio's hand passes through {name}'s shoulder and both of them stare at it.
powers.reveal: SHIMMER! {name} stands, briefly transparent, and steps through the treatment table.

powers.omen: A tiny violet doorway opens under the match ball and politely waits beside {name}.
powers.reveal: WHOOP! {name} rises as the ball drops out of a second doorway behind the huddle.

powers.omen: A translucent copy of {name} sits up half a second before the real one.
powers.reveal: TA-DA! Two versions of {name} stand. Only one remembers the team talk.

powers.omen: {name} answers three questions before anyone has asked them.
powers.reveal: FLASH! {name} opens shining eyes and points exactly where the next pass will go.

powers.omen: The turf dents beneath {name}'s palm. Everyone in the huddle feels the shock before they hear it.
powers.reveal: KRAK! {name} floats upright as the ground shudders. {name} is, quite suddenly, enormous.

powers.omen: Silver threads stitch themselves between {name}'s fingers.
powers.reveal: THWIP! {name} rises inside a perfect web shaped like the club crest.

powers.omen: {name}'s fingertips reach the water bottle from several feet away.
powers.reveal: SPROING! {name} stands, stretches across the entire goalmouth, and snaps cheerfully back.

powers.omen: {name}'s chest rises for a shout that has not come out yet. The whole bench leans in.
powers.reveal: ROAR! {name} bellows, and every teammate's eyes catch light at once.

powers.omen: Frost creeps out from under {name}'s studs and keeps going.
powers.reveal: CRACK! The turf under {name} turns to glass, and nobody else can stand on it.

powers.omen: {name}'s outline goes soft at the edges, like the floodlights forgot them.
powers.reveal: GONE. {name} steps sideways out of everyone's attention and waits there.

powers.omen: The grass around {name} bends inward. So does a discarded water bottle.
powers.reveal: WHUMP! Everything near {name} lurches toward them, and a lane tears open behind.

powers.omen: {name}'s gloves are suddenly too small for {name}'s hands.
powers.reveal: UP! {name} unfolds until the goalmouth looks like a letterbox.

powers.omen: A tight spiral of wind circles {name}'s boots and steals every loose team sheet.
powers.reveal: WHOOSH! {name} rises inside a spinning wall of air that sends the match ball skittering away.
